author: Owled
body:
Hello Avicus Staff Team,
Owled here. So a long while back, I was banned on my account - Owled, for Speed hacking. First of all, I wasn't hacking, and I've never hacked before, but I do not have proof that I wasn't. The mod that banned me was Jiveh at the time, and I don't believe he had proof to ban me either, because when I logged on my account after a week or so, I was banned on Avicus. The reason why I wanted to appeal was to clear things up for my friend, because I was banned from her house and I think she was un aware. I personally don't play Minecraft that much anymore but I don't want her to get punished for when I got banned. I hope I can get appealed from Avicus, and that things can clear up, and I do believe it was a false ban. I think my punishment has been long enough. But anyways, thanks for reading my appeal, regards,

   Owled
